BIQAI-FULL:v7p339#2/r10.claim: The future reading that the moon will split is rejected because there is no contextual indicator to move the past tense into the future, especially given the famous sound report.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p339#2/r10.anchor: ومن قال : المراد به ( سيشق ) يحتاج في صرف الماضي عن حقيقته إلى المستقبل إلى صارف

BIQAI-FULL:v7p339#2/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p339#2/r11.speaker: أبو جعفر ابن الزبير
BIQAI-FULL:v7p339#2/r11.claim: Ibn al-Zubayr links the opening to the preceding account of the final return and Resurrection: the Hour is near so that those able to heed may desist.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p339#2/r11.anchor: وقال الإمام أبو جعفر ابن الزبير : لما أعلمهم سبحانه بأن إليه المنتهى

BIQAI-FULL:v7p341/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p341/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p341/r1.claim: Biqāʿī traces a continuing denunciation of polytheism and resistance to revelation from al-Zumar through Ghāfir and Fuṣṣilat, showing the context of al-Qamar's warning.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p341/r1.anchor: ما يجادل في آيات الله إلا الذين كفروا

BIQAI-FULL:v7p341#2/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p341#2/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p341#2/r1.claim: The sequence of later sūras keeps reproaching deniers through warnings about shirk, rejecting the Qur'an, disputing God's signs, and the fate awaiting disbelievers.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p341#2/r1.anchor: كبر على المشركين ما تدعوهم إليه والذين يحاجون في الله

BIQAI-FULL:v7p342/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p342/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p342/r1.claim: Al-Fatḥ's promise of victory presses the disbelievers more than reproach, while al-Ḥujurāt honors the Prophet and unites believers in ways that frustrate the envious enemy.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p342/r1.anchor: وأما سورة الفتح فما تضمنته من البشارة والفتح أشد على الكفار

BIQAI-FULL:v7p342/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p342/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p342/r2.claim: Al-Dhāriyāt, al-Ṭūr, and al-Najm make the preceding theme especially clear, announcing it in their openings.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p342/r2.anchor: وأما سورة الذاريات والطور والنجم فما تضمنته مما ذكرناه قبل أوضح شيء

BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r1.claim: In al-Aʿrāf, Hūd, al-Muʾminūn, and al-Shuʿarāʾ, narrative admonition begins with gentleness and indirect warning, growing harsher only after repeated calls fail; al-Qamar's direct rebuke of Quraysh completes the shift.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r1.anchor: وذلك غير خاف في التلطف بالموعظة

BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r2.claim: Al-Shuʿarāʾ explicitly rebukes the polytheists, clears the Prophet of their false accusations, and ends by warning wrongdoers of their fate.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r2.anchor: فوبخهم وعنفهم ونزه نبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم عن توهمهم وعظيم إفكهم وافترائهم

BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r3.claim: In al-Shuʿarāʾ, the refrain that each narrated episode contains a sign carries threat and warning, reinforcing the sūra's direct reproof.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p343#2/r3.anchor: إن في ذلك } وفيه تهديد ووعيد

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r1.speaker: author
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r1.claim: The sūra is Meccan and has fifty-five verses.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r1.anchor: مكية وآياتها خمس وخمسون مقدمة السورة

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r2.speaker: ابن عباس وابن الزبير
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas and Ibn al-Zubayr report that Sūrat Iqtarabat al-Sāʿa was revealed in Mecca.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: نزلت بمكة سورة {اقتربت الساعة} وأخرج ابن مردويه عن ابن الزبير مثله

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r3.speaker: البيهقي عن ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r3.claim: A report says the sūra is called the whitening in the Torah and will brighten its reciter's face on the Day of Resurrection; al-Bayhaqi grades it munkar.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: قارىء اقتربت تدعى في التوراة المبيضة تبيض وجه صاحبها يوم تبيض الوجوه قال البيهقي: منكر

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r4.speaker: عائشة
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r4.claim: A raised report from Aisha promises light, protection from Satan and idolatry, and higher ranks for reciting al-Sajda, Ya-Sin, al-Qamar, and al-Mulk.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r4.anchor: عن عائشة مرفوعا من قرأ (بالم تنزيل) و (يس) و {اقتربت الساعة} و {تبارك الذي بيده الملك} كن له نورا

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r5.speaker: إسحق بن عبد الله بن أبي فروة
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r5.claim: A raised report says that whoever recites the opening of the sūra every other night will be resurrected with a face like the full moon.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r5.anchor: عن إسحق بن عبد الله بن أبي فروة رفعه من قرأ {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر} في كل ليلتين بعثه الله يوم القيامة ووجهه كالقمر ليلة البدر

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r6.speaker: ليث عن معن عن شيخ من همدان
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r6.claim: Another raised report promises a moon-like face to whoever regularly reads the sūra every other night until death.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r6.anchor: عن ليث عن معن عن شيخ من همدان رفعه إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: من قرأ {اقتربت الساعة} غبا ليلة وليلة حتى يموت

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r7.speaker: بريدة
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r7.claim: Buraida reports that after a man left Muʿadh's long ʿIsha prayer because of work and concern for irrigation, the Prophet advised praying with al-Shams wa-Duḥāhā or similar sūras.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r7.anchor: عن بريدة أن معاذا بن جبل صلى بأصحابه صلاة العشاء فقرأ فيها {اقتربت الساعة} فقام رجل من قبل أن يفرغ

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r8.speaker: أنس
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r8.claim: Anas says Meccans asked the Prophet for a sign, so the moon split into two parts in Mecca; the verse was revealed through the phrase about passing magic.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r8.anchor: عن أنس قال: سأل أهل مكة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم آية فانشق القمر بمكة فرقتين فنزلت {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر} إلى قوله {سحر مستمر}

DURR-FULL:v7p669/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r10.speaker: أنس
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r10.claim: A second report from Anas says the Meccans asked for a sign, and the Prophet showed them the moon split in two with Mount Hira visible between its halves.
DURR-FULL:v7p669/r10.anchor: عن أنس أن أهل مكة سألوا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يريهم آية فأراهم القمر شقتين حتى رأوا حراء بينهما

DURR-FULL:v7p670/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r1.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r1.claim: Ibn Masud saw the moon split in Mecca into halves over Abu Qubays and al-Suwayda; people called it magic, and the verse came down. Al-Hakim graded the report sound.
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r1.anchor: عن أبي معمر عن ابن مسعود قال: رأيت القمر منشقا شقتين بمكة

DURR-FULL:v7p670/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r2.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r2.claim: Mujahid says that just as they saw the moon split, the warning that the Hour had drawn near is true.
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r2.anchor: قال مجاهد: يقول كما رأيتم القمر منشقا فإن الذي أخبركم عن {اقتربت الساعة} حق

DURR-FULL:v7p670/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r3.claim: Ibn Masud reports that in the Prophet’s time the moon split into two parts on either side of a mountain; the Prophet told them to bear witness.
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r3.anchor: من طريق أبي معمر عن ابن مسعود قال: انشق القمر على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فرقتين

DURR-FULL:v7p670/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r4.speaker: عبد الله
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r4.claim: Abdullah saw the moon over a mountain split and could see the mountain between its two gaps. Al-Hakim graded the report sound.
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r4.anchor: عن عبد الله قال: رأيت القمر على الجبل وقد انشق فأبصرت الجبل من بين فرجتي القمر

DURR-FULL:v7p670/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r5.claim: Ibn Masud says Quraysh called the split moon magic and waited for travelers, who confirmed seeing it; then the verse was revealed.
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r5.anchor: عن ابن مسعود قال: انشق القمر على عهد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالت قريش: هذا سحر ابن أبي كبشة

DURR-FULL:v7p670/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas says the moon split during the Prophet’s lifetime.
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: انشق القمر في زمان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

DURR-FULL:v7p670/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r7.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r7.claim: At Mina, Ibn Masud says the moon split in two, one part disappearing behind a mountain, and the Prophet said, Bear witness.
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r7.anchor: عن ابن مسعود قال: كنا مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بمنى فانشق القمر حتى صار فرقتين

DURR-FULL:v7p670/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r8.speaker: ابن عمر
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r8.claim: Ibn Umar says the moon split in the Prophet’s time, with one half before the mountain and the other behind it; the Prophet asked God to bear witness.
DURR-FULL:v7p670/r8.anchor: عن ابن عمر في قوله {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر} قال: كان ذلك على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

DURR-FULL:v7p671/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r1.speaker: جبير بن مطعم
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r1.claim: Jubayr ibn Mutim says the moon split over two mountains in Mecca; people accused Muhammad of magic, but one man said he could not bewitch everyone.
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r1.anchor: عن جبير بن مطعم في قوله {وانشق القمر} قال: انشق القمر ونحن بمكة على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

DURR-FULL:v7p671/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says the split occurred before the Hijra, and people saw the two halves.
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر} قال: قد مضى ذلك قبل الهجرة انشق القمر حتى رأوا شقيه

DURR-FULL:v7p671/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that the moon was eclipsed in the Prophet’s time; people called it magic, and the verse through “mustamirr” was revealed.
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r3.anchor: من طريق عكرمة عن ابن عباس قال: كسف القمر على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالوا: سحر القمر فنزلت {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر} إلى قوله {مستمر}

DURR-FULL:v7p671/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas recounts that Quraysh leaders demanded a split moon, promising belief; on the night of Badr, God granted their request, and the Prophet called witnesses to see it over Abu Qubays and Qayqa'an.
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r4.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر} قال: اجتمع المشركون على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

DURR-FULL:v7p671/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas says Gabriel foretold a sign for that night; on the fourteenth, the moon split above al-Safa and al-Marwa, but Meccans repeatedly dismissed it as passing magic, prompting the verse.
DURR-FULL:v7p671/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: انتهى أهل مكة إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالوا: هل من آية نعرف بها أنك رسول الله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r1.claim: Reading the verse's split as an eschatological sign does not deny the historical miracle requested by the pagans; the author says that event is not the referent here and can be reconciled through another version of the report.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r1.anchor: وهذا لا ينافي وقوع انشقاق القمر الذي سأله المشركون ولكنه غير المراد في هذه الآية لكنه مؤول بما في روايته عند غير الترمذي .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r2.speaker: أنس بن مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r2.claim: A report from Anas says the verse was revealed after the moon had split.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r2.anchor: ولحديث أنس بن مالك أن الآية نزلت بعد انشقاق القمر .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r3.claim: Across the transmitted accounts discussed, the moon's splitting as a miracle occurred in worldly life.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r3.anchor: وعلى جميع تلك الروايات فانشقاق القمر الذي هو معجزة حصل في الدنيا .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r4.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r4.claim: In al-Bukhārī, Ibn Masʿūd says five signs had passed: al-lizām, the Romans, the great seizure, the moon, and the smoke.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r4.anchor: وفي البخاري } عن ابن مسعود أنه قال : ( خمس قد مضين اللزام والروم والبطشة والقمر والدخان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r5.speaker: الحسن
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r5.claim: Al-Ḥasan says the moon will split at the Resurrection.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r5.anchor: وعن الحسن وعطاء أن انشقاق القمر يكون عند القيامة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r6.speaker: عطاء
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r6.claim: ʿAṭāʾ says the moon will split at the Resurrection.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r6.anchor: وعن الحسن وعطاء أن انشقاق القمر يكون عند القيامة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r7.speaker: القشيري
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r7.claim: Al-Qushayrī chose the interpretation that the split occurs at the Resurrection.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r8.speaker: البلخي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r8.claim: The future splitting interpretation is also transmitted from al-Balkhī.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r9.speaker: الماوردي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r9.claim: Al-Māwardī attributes the future-splitting interpretation to the majority.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r9.anchor: وقال الماوردي : هو قول الجمهور ، ولا يعرف ذلك للجمهور .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r10.claim: The author says the future-splitting interpretation is not known as a majority position.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r10.anchor: وقال الماوردي : هو قول الجمهور ، ولا يعرف ذلك للجمهور .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r11.claim: The moon-splitting report is treated in works on the Prophet's life and proofs of prophethood.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r11.anchor: وخبر انشقاق القمر معدود في مباحث المعجزات من كتب ( السيرة ) و ( دلائل النبوة ) .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r12.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r12.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r12.claim: The verse does not state the event explicitly, though its apparent sense entails it, as al-Shifāʾ says.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r12.anchor: وليس لفظ هذه الآية صريحا في وقوعه ولكن ظاهر الآية يقتضيه كما في ( الشفاء ) .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r13.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r13.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r13.claim: If revelation followed the split, the opening warns people though the miracle already proved the point; the past tense is literal, and the changed celestial order prompts reflection on the world's eventual disappearance.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r13.anchor: فإن كان نزول هذه الآية واقعا بعد حصول الانشقاق كما اقتضاه حديث ابن مسعود في ( جامع الترمذي ) فتصدير السورة ب { اقتربت الساعة } للاهتمام بالموعظة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r14.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r14.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r14.claim: The author cites Ibn Masʿūd's report in al-Tirmidhī as evidence for revelation after the splitting.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r14.anchor: كما اقتضاه حديث ابن مسعود في ( جامع الترمذي )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r15.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r15.speaker: حذيفة بن اليمان
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r15.claim: Ḥudhayfa ibn al-Yamān is reported to have read wa-qad inshaqqa al-qamar, making the split explicitly prior.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r15.anchor: وروي أن حذيفة بن اليمان قرأ { وقد انشق القمر } .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r16.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r16.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r16.claim: If the verse preceded the split, it warns of the approaching Hour and its lunar sign while hinting that the requested split will also be a miracle.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r16.anchor: وإن كان نزولها قبل حصول الانشقاق كما اقتضاه حديث أنس بن مالك فهو إنذار باقتراب الساعة وانشقاق القمر الذي هو من أشراط الساعة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r17.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r17.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r17.claim: The following verse's report that people turn away from a sign and call it sorcery supports the pre-event interpretation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r17.anchor: ويرجح هذا المحمل قوله تعالى عقبه : { وإن يروا آية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر } ( القمر : 2 )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r18.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r18.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r18.claim: Most early and later exegetes took the split to have happened before or near revelation; the author explains its possibility amid variant reports to answer deniers and reassure believers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p168/r18.anchor: وإذ قد حمل معظم السلف من المفسرين ومن خلفهم هذه الآية على أن انشقاق القمر حصل قبل نزولها أو بقرب نزولها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r1.speaker: ابن كيسان
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r1.claim: Ibn Kaysan reads the clauses in event order as the moon splitting first and the Hour approaching, while noting that waw itself does not order events.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r1.anchor: قال ابن كيسان : هو على التقديم والتأخير .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r2.claim: Splitting is a gap or fissure through a body's surface that does not detach a piece from the whole; it can also describe a crack in wood or a wall.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r2.anchor: والشق : فرج وتفرق بين أديم جسم ما بحيث لا تنفصل قطعة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r3.claim: A surface cleft in the moon is literal splitting; loss of part of its light is metaphorical, while separation into two halves is a metonymy.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r3.anchor: فإطلاق الانشقاق على حدوث هوة في سطح القمر إطلاق حقيقي وإطلاقه على انطماس بعض ضوئه استعارة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r4.claim: The form of approaching is originally a verb of accepting an agent's action; here it intensifies the sense of nearness.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r4.anchor: والاقتراب أصله صيغة مطاوعة ، أي قبول فعل الفاعل ، وهو هنا للمبالغة في القرب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r5.claim: Literal nearness is relative to the immense time since creation, as in the Prophet's comparison of his mission and the Hour to two adjacent fingers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r5.anchor: قول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ( بعثت أنا والساعة كهاتين )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r6.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r6.claim: The Prophet said that he and the Hour were sent like two fingers together, gesturing with his index and middle fingers; Ibn Ashur gives no grading here.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r6.anchor: قول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ( بعثت أنا والساعة كهاتين ) وأشار بسبابته والوسطى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r7.claim: People cannot determine the world's lifespan from creation, and Jewish chronologies rest on conjecture; the relative-nearness framing urges repentance and preparation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r7.anchor: فإن تحديد المدة من وقت خلق العالم أو من وقت خلق الإنسان أمر لا قبل للناس به وما يوجد في كتب اليهود مبنى على الحدس والتوهمات

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r8.speaker: ابن عطية
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r8.claim: Ibn Atiyya says reports that specify the age of the world are weak and unreliable.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r8.anchor: قال ابن عطية : ( وكل ما يروى من التحديد في عمر الدنيا فضعيف واهن )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r9.claim: The reminder of nearness should lead people to abandon idolatry, increase good works, and avoid sins before Judgment.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r9.anchor: وفائدة هذا الاعتبار أن يقبل الناس على نبذ الشرك وعلى الاستكثار من الأعمال الصالحات

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r10.claim: By established usage, the Hour names the time when this world ends.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r10.anchor: والساعة : علم بالغلبة على وقت فناء هذا العالم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r11.claim: Alternatively, the Hour may mean the familiar promised hour of the polytheists' destruction by Muslim swords.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r11.anchor: ويجوز أن يراد بالساعة ساعة معهودة أنذروا بها في آيات كثيرة وهي ساعة استئصال المشركين بسيوف المسلمين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r12.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r12.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r12.claim: If nearness is figurative for possibility, the moon's splitting makes the previously inconceivable end of the world intelligible by analogy with a lesser event.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r12.anchor: وإن حمل القرب على المجاز ، أي الدلالة على الإمكان ، فالمعنى : اتضح للناس ما كانوا يجدونه محالا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r13.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r13.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r13.claim: If the verse followed the moon's splitting, its informative wording serves as admonition: the known event may be a sign of the Hour, since splitting is a kind of lunar eclipse.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r13.anchor: والخبر مستعمل في لازم معناه وهو الموعظة إن كانت الآية نزلت بعد انشقاق القمر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r14.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r14.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r14.claim: The moon's split is likened to the moon's being darkened in the warning about the Day of Resurrection; the timing of the Hour's signs is not fixed.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p170/r14.anchor: فما الانشقاق إلا نوع من الخسف فإن أشراط الساعة وعلاماتها غير محدودة الأزمنة في القرب والبعد من مشروطها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r1.claim: Iqtarabat means it drew near, more emphatically than qarubat, just as iqtadara is stronger than qadara.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r1.anchor: اقتربت معناه: قربت إلا أنه أبلغ، كما أن اقتدر أبلغ من قدر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r2.claim: The Hour’s timing is unknown and unspecified, though it has drawn near.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r2.anchor: و: الساعة القيامة وأمرها مجهول التحديد لم يعلم، إلا أنها قربت دون تحديد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r3.speaker: النبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r3.claim: The Prophet said he and the Hour were sent like these two fingers, pointing to index and middle fingers.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r3.anchor: وقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «بعثت أنا والساعة كهاتين»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r4.speaker: أنس عن النبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r4.claim: Near sunset the Prophet said the world remaining compared with what had passed was like the remainder of that day.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r4.anchor: وقال أنس: خطب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وقد كادت الشمس تغيب فقال: «ما بقي من الدنيا فيما مضى إلا كمثل ما بقي من هذا اليوم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r5.speaker: النبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r5.claim: The Prophet hoped God would delay the community for half a day; Ibn ʿAṭiyya says this was a hope, not a definitive report, and God delayed it longer.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r5.anchor: وقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إني لأرجو أن يؤخر الله أمتي نصف يوم»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r6.claim: Reports that set the world’s total lifespan are weak and unreliable.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r6.anchor: وكل ما يروى عن عمر الدنيا من التحديد فضعيف واهن

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r7.claim: The verse reports an event already occurred; the future Day of Resurrection reading is weak and contrary to consensus.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r7.anchor: وقوله: انشق القمر إخبار عما وقع في ذلك، وذكر الثعلبي أنه قيل إن المعنى ينشق القمر يوم القيامة، وهذا ضعيف الأمة على خلافه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r8.speaker: الجمهور
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r8.claim: The majority connect it to Quraysh asking the Prophet for a sign; another view says they actually witnessed the split.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r8.anchor: وذلك أن قريشا سألت رسول الله آية فقيل مجملة، وهذا قول الجمهور، وقيل بل عاينوا شق القمر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r9.speaker: ابن عباس عند الثعلبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r9.claim: Al-Thaʿlabī reports from Ibn ʿAbbās that God showed the split to the Prophet, Muslims, and unbelievers; Quraysh called it magic and travelers confirmed it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r9.anchor: ذكره الثعلبي عن ابن عباس فأراهم الله انشقاق القمر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r10.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود وجبير بن مطعم وعبد الله بن عمر وأنس وابن عباس وحذيفة بن اليمان
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r10.claim: The source names Ibn Masʿūd and Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim among eyewitnesses, and Ibn ʿUmar, Anas, Ibn ʿAbbās, and Ḥudhayfa among those reporting it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r10.anchor: وممن قال من الصحابة رأيته: عبد الله بن مسعود وجبير بن مطعم وأخبر به عبد الله بن عمر وأنس وابن عباس وحذيفة بن اليمان

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r11.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r11.claim: Ibn Masʿūd said one portion of the split Moon went behind Mount Ḥirāʾ.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r11.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود: رأيته انشق فذهبت فرقة وراء جبل حراء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r12.speaker: ابن زيد
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r12.claim: Ibn Zayd says one half appeared over Qayquʿān and the other over Abū Qubays.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r12.anchor: وقال ابن زيد: كان يرى نصفه على قعيقعان والآخر على أبي قبيس

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r13.speaker: حذيفة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r13.claim: Ḥudhayfa read with qad before انشق القمر; al-Thaʿlabī also reports a version without wāw.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p211#3/r13.anchor: وقرأ حذيفة: «اقتربت الساعة وقد انشق القمر»

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r1.claim: Iqtarabat means ‘drew near,’ and al-sāʿa is the Resurrection.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r2.speaker: الفراء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r2.claim: Al-Farrāʾ proposes an inverted word order: the meaning is that the moon split and the Hour drew near.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r2.anchor: قال الفراء فيه تقديم وتأخير تقديره انشق القمر واقتربت الساعة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r3.claim: Mujāhid says the moon split into two parts, one remaining visible and the other going behind the mountain.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r3.anchor: وقال مجاهد انشق القمر فصار فرقتين فثبتت فرقة وذهبت فرقة وراء الجبل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r4.speaker: ابن زيد
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r4.claim: Ibn Zayd says one half of the split moon appeared over Qayqaʿān and the other over Abū Qubays.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r4.anchor: وقال ابن زيد لما انشق القمر كان يرى نصفه على قعيقعان والنصف الآخر على أبي قبيس

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r5.claim: Ibn Masʿūd reports that Quraysh called the event magic by Ibn Abī Kabsha, asked travelers, and accepted their confirmation that they had seen it; the verse was then revealed.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p88/r5.anchor: قال ابن مسعود لما انشق القمر قالت قريش سحركم ابن أبي كبشة فاسألوا السفار

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r1.claim: The Hour is near and the world's term is ending, as also indicated by 16:1 and 21:1.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r1.anchor: يخبر تعالى عن اقتراب الساعة وفراغ الدنيا وانقضائها. كما قال تعالى: {أتى أمر الله فلا تستعجلوه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r2.speaker: أنس عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r2.claim: Anas reports the Prophet saying near sunset that the world remaining is to its elapsed portion like the little of that day left after most of it passed. Ibn Kathir notes the chain centers on Khalaf ibn Musa and his father; Ibn Hibban lists the father among reliable narrators but says he sometimes erred.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r2.anchor: عن أنس أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم خطب أصحابه ذات يوم، وقد كادت الشمس أن تغرب فلم يبق منها إلا شف (4) يسير

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r3.speaker: ابن عمر
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r3.claim: Ibn Umar reports the Prophet comparing people's lifetimes with those before them to the fraction of the day already elapsed compared with what remained; Ibn Kathir calls this a supporting explanation of the preceding report.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r3.anchor: عن مجاهد، عن ابن عمر قال: كنا جلوسا عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم والشمس على قعيقعان بعد العصر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r4.speaker: سهل بن سعد عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r4.claim: The Prophet said he and the Hour were sent like the index and middle fingers; the report is in both Sahih collections through Abu Hazim Salama ibn Dinar.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r4.anchor: عن سهل بن سعد قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "بعثت والساعة (1) هكذا". وأشار بإصبعيه: السبابة والوسطى

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r5.speaker: وهب السوائي عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r5.claim: Wahb al-Suwa'i reports the Prophet saying he and the Hour are like these two fingers, with the Hour almost overtaking him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r5.anchor: عن وهب السوائي قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "بعثت أنا والساعة كهذه من هذه إن كادت لتسبقها (3) "

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r6.speaker: أنس بن مالك عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r6.claim: Anas tells al-Walid ibn Abd al-Malik that he heard the Prophet say, 'You and the Hour are like these two'; the next segment notes that Ahmad alone transmits it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p470#2/r6.anchor: قال: قدم أنس بن مالك على الوليد بن عبد الملك فسأله: ماذا سمعت من رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يذكر به الساعة؟

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r1.claim: Ibn Kathir says Ahmad alone transmits the preceding report that the Prophet said, 'You and the Hour are like these two.'

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r2.claim: A sound report gives the Prophet the name al-Hashir, the one at whose feet people will be gathered.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r2.anchor: وشاهد ذلك أيضا في الصحيح في أسماء رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: أنه الحاشر الذي يحشر الناس على قدميه.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r3.speaker: عتبة بن غزوان عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r3.claim: In a sermon, the Prophet says worldly life is nearly over, urges preparation for the lasting abode, describes a stone falling in Hell for seventy years without reaching its bottom, and says Paradise will become crowded. Ibn Kathir says Muslim alone transmits the report.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r3.anchor: عن خالد بن عمير قال: خطب عتبة بن غزوان -قال بهز: وقال قبل هذه المرة-خطبنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: فحمد الله

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r4.speaker: حذيفة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r4.claim: Hudhayfa links the verse to the Hour's nearness and the moon's splitting, saying the present is the racecourse and tomorrow the race; his father explains the contest is in deeds, with Hell as the destination and the winner being the one who reaches Paradise first.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p471/r4.anchor: فحضر أبي وحضرت معه فخطبنا حذيفة فقال: ألا إن الله يقول:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r1.claim: The moon split during the Prophet’s lifetime; sound, mass-transmitted reports establish it, and scholars agree it was one of his manifest miracles.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r1.anchor: قد كان هذا في زمان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r2.claim: Ibn Masud counted the Romans, smoke, al-lizam, the mighty seizure, and the moon among five signs that had already occurred.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r2.anchor: عن ابن مسعود أنه قال: "خمس قد مضين: الروم، والدخان،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r3.speaker: أنس بن مالك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r3.claim: Anas reports that Meccans asked the Prophet for a sign and the moon split twice at Mecca; al-Bukhari’s version says they saw Mount Hira between its halves.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r3.anchor: عن أنس بن مالك قال: سأل أهل مكة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r4.speaker: جبير بن مطعم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r4.claim: Jubayr reports two portions appeared over separate mountains; Quraysh called it magic but reasoned Muhammad could not bewitch everyone. Ahmad alone gives this route; al-Bayhaqi and al-Tabari also transmit it through other routes.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p472/r4.anchor: رواية جبير بن مطعم رضي الله عنه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r1.claim: Al-Bukhari reports Ibn Abbas saying the moon split in the Prophet’s time; al-Bukhari and Muslim also transmit the same report by another route.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: انشق القمر في زمان رسول

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r2.claim: In Ibn Abbas’s explanation, the split had already happened before the Hijra, and observers saw both halves; al-Awfi reports a similar explanation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله: {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر. وإن يروا آية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r3.claim: In a report through Ikrima, the moon was eclipsed in the Prophet’s time, people called it bewitched, and verses 54:1–2 were revealed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: كسف القمر على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالوا: سحر القمر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r4.speaker: عبد الله بن عمر
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r4.claim: Ibn Umar says the moon split into two parts, one on each side of a mountain, and the Prophet said, “God, bear witness”; Muslim and al-Tirmidhi transmit it, which al-Tirmidhi grades hasan sahih.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r4.anchor: عن عبد الله بن عمر في قوله تعالى: {اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر} قال: وقد كان ذلك على عهد رسول الله

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r5.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r5.claim: Ibn Masud says the moon split into two in the Prophet’s time, so people saw it, and the Prophet told them to bear witness.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p473/r5.anchor: عن ابن مسعود قال: انشق القمر على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم شقين حتى نظروا إليه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r1.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r1.claim: Al-Bukhari and Muslim transmit Ibn Masud’s report through Sufyan ibn Uyayna and also through al-Amash, Ibrahim, and Abu Maamar.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r1.anchor: وهكذا رواه البخاري ومسلم، من حديث سفيان بن عيينة، به

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r2.speaker: عبد الله
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r2.claim: Al-Tabari reports Ibn Masud recalling that at Mina one portion of the split moon went behind a mountain and the Prophet repeatedly said, “Bear witness.”
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r2.anchor: عن عبد الله، قال: كنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بمنى فانشق القمر، فأخذت فرقة خلف الجبل

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r3.speaker: أبو الضحى
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r3.claim: Al-Bukhari cites Abu al-Duha from Masruq, from Abdullah, locating the event in Mecca.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r3.anchor: وقال أبو الضحى، عن مسروق، عن عبد الله: بمكة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r4.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r4.claim: Quraysh called it magic by Ibn Abi Kabsha and asked travelers whether they had seen it; travelers arriving from every direction confirmed it, and al-Tabari’s account adds that the verse was then revealed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r4.anchor: عن مسروق، عن عبد الله بن مسعود، قال: انشق القمر على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، فقالت قريش

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r5.speaker: محمد بن سيرين
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r5.claim: Ibn Sirin says he was informed that Ibn Masud used to affirm that the moon had split.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r5.anchor: عن محمد -هو ابن سيرين-قال: نبئت أن ابن مسعود

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r6.speaker: عبد الله
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r6.claim: Ibrahim reports from al-Aswad that Abdullah personally saw the mountain through the opening in the split moon.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p474/r6.anchor: عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود، عن عبد الله قال: لقد رأيت الجبل من فرج القمر حين انشق

JISHUMI:v9p6673/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r1.claim: The commentators classify the sūra as Meccan and count fifty-five verses.
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r1.anchor: مكية فيما ذكره المفسرون، وهي خمس وخمسون آية.

JISHUMI:v9p6673/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r2.speaker: النبي
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r2.claim: A report from Ubayy says morning recitation brings a full-moon-like face at resurrection, while nightly recitation makes the face shine over others; no grading is stated.
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r2.anchor: وعن أبي، عن النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم -: من قرأ سورة (اقتربت الساعة) في كل غداة بعث يوم القيامة

JISHUMI:v9p6673/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r3.claim: After al-Najm ended with the Resurrection, this sūra opens with its nearness and signs, already manifest in the moon's splitting and the Messenger's coming.
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r3.anchor: ولما ختم سورة (النجم) بذكر القيامة، افتتح هذه السورة. باقترابها، وذكر علاماتها، وأنها ظهرت، وهو انشقاق القمر، ومجيء الرسول

JISHUMI:v9p6673/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r4.speaker: ابن كيسان
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r4.claim: The common reading puts the Hour's nearness before the moon's splitting; Ibn Kaysān says the intended order is the splitting followed by the Hour's nearness.
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r4.anchor: قراءة العامة: (اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر)، قال ابن كيسان: تقديره: انشق القمر واقتربت الساعة.

JISHUMI:v9p6673/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r5.speaker: حذيفة
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r5.claim: Ḥudhayfa reads وقد before انشق القمر: “The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has indeed split.”
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r5.anchor: وقرأ حذيفة: (اقتربت الساعة وقد انشق القمر).

JISHUMI:v9p6673/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r9.claim: اقتربت means “came near”; its افتعل form intensifies the sense, like preparing a roast with extra care or deliberately taking something.
JISHUMI:v9p6673/r9.anchor: اقتربت: افتعل من القرب، ومعناه: قرب، إلا أن في اقتربت زيادة مبالغة؛ لأن أصل افتعل

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r1.claim: Iqtarabat means that the Hour has drawn near; the cited verse expresses nearness poetically.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r1.anchor: قد اقتربت لو كان في قرب دارها … جداء ولكن قد تضر وتنفع

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r2.anchor: والمراد بالساعة القيامة , وفي تسميتها بالساعة وجهان

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r3.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r3.claim: It may be called the Hour because events unfold quickly then.

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r4.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r4.claim: Alternatively, it is called the Hour because it arrives during an hour of its day.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r4.anchor: الثاني : لمجيئها في ساعة من يومها

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r5.speaker: النبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r5.claim: Ibn Masud reports the Prophet saying the Hour has drawn near, while people grow more avid for worldly life and more distant from it.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r5.anchor: عن ابن مسعود قال : قال رسول الله

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r6.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r6.claim: One figurative reading is that the matter became clear and manifest, as illustrated by the cited poem.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r6.anchor: معناه وضح الأمر وظهر والعرب تضرب مثلا فيما وضح أمره

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r7.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r7.claim: Another figurative reading is the moon's emergence as it parts the darkness, like dawn described as splitting; al-Nabigha al-Ja'di's line supports this usage.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r7.anchor: وقد يعبر عن انفلاقه بانشقاقه , كما قال النابغة الجعدي

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r8.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r8.claim: A literal split will occur after the Hour, at the second trumpet blast; Hasan argues everyone would otherwise have seen such a sign.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r8.anchor: أنه ينشق بعد مجيء الساعة وهي النفخة الثانية , قاله الحسن

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r9.speaker: الجمهور
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r9.claim: The majority and apparent wording place the literal lunar split in Muhammad's lifetime, after Hamza asked for a sign to strengthen his faith following Abu Jahl's insult.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r9.anchor: وهو قول الجمهور وظاهر التنزيل أن القمر انشق على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r10.speaker: أبو مسعود
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r10.claim: Abu Masud says he saw the moon split in Mecca before the Hijra, one half over Abu Qubays and one over al-Suwayda.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r10.anchor: عن أبي مسعود قال : رأيت القمر منشقا شقتين بمكة

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r11.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r11.claim: The account says observers called the moon bewitched and the verse was then revealed.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p408#2/r11.anchor: بمكة قبل مخرج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى المدينة

MUJAHID:v2p635/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p635/r1.speaker: جد محمد بن جبير بن مطعم
MUJAHID:v2p635/r1.claim: Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim's grandfather reports that the moon split while they were in Mecca.
MUJAHID:v2p635/r1.anchor: عن محمد بن جبير بن مطعم عن أبيه عن جده في قوله ﴿ اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر ﴾ قال انشق القمر ونحن بمكة

MUQATIL:54:1-6/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:54:1-6/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:54:1-6/r1.claim: The Hour means the Resurrection; its signs include Muhammad's coming, the smoke, and the splitting of the moon.
MUQATIL:54:1-6/r1.anchor: يعني القيامة، ومن علامة ذلك، خروج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، والدخان، وانشقاق القمر

MUQATIL:54:1-6/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:54:1-6/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:54:1-6/r2.claim: When Meccan unbelievers asked Muhammad for a sign, the moon split into two, and they called it magic.
MUQATIL:54:1-6/r2.anchor: وذلك أن كفار مكة سألوا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يريهم آية فانشق القمر نصفين، فقالوا: هذا عمل السحرة

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r1.claim: Iqtarabat means drew near, like 53:57; the Hour is near because most of the world's time has passed.

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r2.speaker: قتادة عن أنس
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r2.claim: Qatada transmits that the Prophet preached near sunset and compared the world's remaining time with the small part of that day left.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r2.anchor: كما روى قتادة عن أنس قال:

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r3.speaker: كعب ووهب
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r3.claim: Kaʿb and Wahb say the world lasts six thousand years; Wahb says 5,600 had passed, as cited by al-Nahhas.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r3.anchor: وقال كعب ووهب: الدنيا ستة الاف سنة.

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r4.claim: The verse says the moon has already split.

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r5.speaker: حذيفة
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r5.claim: Hudhayfa reads the phrase with an added qad: the moon has already split.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r5.anchor: وكذا قرأ حذيفة «اقتربت الساعة وقد انشق القمر»

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r6.speaker: ابن مسعود وابن عمر وأنس وجبير بن مطعم وابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r6.claim: Most scholars affirm the historical split, supported by reports in al-Bukhari and other collections from these Companions.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r6.anchor: وعلى هذا الجمهور من العلماء ثبت ذلك في صحيح البخاري وغيره من حديث ابن مسعود

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r7.speaker: أنس
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r7.claim: Anas says Meccans asked for a sign and the moon split twice; al-Tirmidhi grades the report hasan sahih.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r7.anchor: وعن أنس قال: سأل أهل مكة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم آية

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r8.speaker: أنس
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r8.claim: Al-Bukhari's wording from Anas says the moon split into two parts.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r8.anchor: ولفظ البخاري عن أنس قال: انشق القمر فرقتين

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r9.speaker: قوم والقشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r9.claim: Some, including al-Qushayri, say the moon has not split yet but will split at the Hour with the sky and its contents.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r9.anchor: وقال قوم: لم يقع انشقاق القمر بعد وهو منتظر

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r10.speaker: الماوردي
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r10.claim: Al-Mawardi reports this as the majority view: if the split had occurred, everyone would have seen the sign.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r10.anchor: وذكر الماوردي: أن هذا قول الجمهور

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r11.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r11.claim: Hasan says the Hour draws near when it arrives, and the moon splits after the second trumpet blast.
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r11.anchor: وقال الحسن: اقتربت الساعة فإذا جاءت

QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r12.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:54:1-2/r12.claim: Another view says the moon's splitting means the matter became clear, as Arabs compare clarity to the moon.
